weekly_theme.summary: 水星目前正在逆行（落在天蠍座，10/24–11/13），這段時間適合放慢腳步、重新確認訊息，避免倉促簽約或做重大決定。 太陽剛進入天蠍座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天蠍座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，為你生活中的一些關鍵時刻做好準備。這是一個完美的機會，可以將您雄心勃勃的計劃和創新思想完善並植根於更具行動性的事物中。隨著一切進展迅速，你可能會對在哪裡潛水感到不確定。暫時把這個問題放在一邊。專注於以清晰和信念表達您的想法。這將為新機會的出現鋪平道路。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, prepare for some pivotal moments in your life. It's the perfect opportunity to refine and ground your ambitious plans and innovative thoughts into something more actionable. With everything moving at a rapid pace, you might feel uncertain about where to dive in. Set that concern aside for now. Focus on articulating your ideas with clarity and conviction. This will pave the way for new opportunities to emerge.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，現在是你提升溝通技巧的時候了。擁抱成長，達到新的高度。在過去的三週裡，你進行了深入的思考，闡明了你的價值觀和信念。現在，你正進入一個鼓勵你將這些見解付諸實踐的階段。當天的能量充滿活力，因此請抓住這個機會並採取行動！
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, it's your moment to elevate your communication skills. Embrace growth and reach for new heights. Over the past three weeks, you've engaged in deep reflection, clarifying your values and beliefs. Now, you're entering a phase that encourages you to bring those insights to life. The energy of the day is vibrant and expansive, so seize this opportunity and take action!

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，新的篇章正在為你展開，促使你拋棄過時的信念和思維模式。是時候清除雜亂並擁抱新的觀點了。這段時間的心理整頓至關重要，因為你會意識到你所依賴的熟悉的敘述不再有效。聚集您的優勢，建立真正反映您願望的新基礎。
gemini.horoscope_en: A fresh chapter is unfolding for you, Gemini, prompting you to discard outdated beliefs and thought patterns. It's time to clear the clutter and embrace new perspectives. This period of mental decluttering is crucial, as you'll realize that the familiar narratives you've relied on are no longer effective. Gather your strengths and build a new foundation that truly reflects your aspirations.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，你可能會覺得自己搖搖欲墜，雙腿不穩定地懸掛在邊緣。當你在狹窄的窗臺上感到不確定時，你正在尋找可以掌握的東西。你可能會發誓，一旦你通過這個艱難的地方，你將來會避開它。但深呼吸；這只是生命起伏的一部分。 這些艱難時刻對您的成長至關重要，最終使您對未來更順暢的道路更有韌性和感激之情。
cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, it might feel as though you're teetering on the brink, with your legs hanging precariously over the edge. You're on the lookout for something to grasp while your footing feels uncertain on a narrow ledge. You might be vowing that once you navigate through this tough spot, you'll steer clear of it in the future. But take a deep breath; this is simply part of life's ebb and flow. These tough moments are essential for your growth, ultimately making you more resilient and grateful for the smoother paths ahead.

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，感覺就像一場旋風席捲了你的生活，把你精心組織的計劃分散到混亂之中。在如何恢復秩序的不同意見的喧囂中，您可能會發現自己被對您的要求所淹沒。花點時間停下來，向身邊的人表達你的感受。他們可能會同情你的挑戰，並提供支持。請記住，這場風暴會過去，平靜會恢復。
leo.horoscope_en: Leo, it feels like a whirlwind has just swept through your life, scattering your carefully organized plans into disarray. Amidst the clamor of differing opinions on how to restore order, you may find yourself overwhelmed by the demands being placed on you. Take a moment to pause and express your feelings to those around you. They will likely empathize with your challenges and offer their support. Remember, this storm will pass, and calm will return.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，小心不要被別人的話纏住。你可能會誤解他們的訊息，只是因為你沒有完全接收到訊息。你的想法可能會急躁，雖然你可能會對一些不適合你的東西做出尖銳的反應，但練習積極聆聽是很重要的。當別人說話時，即使他們的觀點與您的觀點不同，也要安靜地進行內心對話，以示體諒。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, be cautious not to get caught up in the words of others. You might be misinterpreting their messages simply because you're not fully tuned in. Your thoughts may be racing, and while you may react sharply to something that doesn't sit well with you, it's important to practice active listening. Show consideration by quieting your inner dialogue when someone else is speaking, even if their views differ from yours.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，今天帶來了美妙的擴張感，你可能會比其他任何人都更喜歡它。雖然其他人可能會發現這種能量壓倒性，導致壓力，但對你來說，這是放大成就感的機會。請注意，不要讓這種熱情導致過度放縱，尤其是在食物方面。除此之外，完全擁抱這一天--無論你從事什麼，都必然會產生偉大的結果。
libra.horoscope_en: Today brings a wonderful sense of expansion, Libra, and you'll likely savor it more than anyone else. While others may find this energy overwhelming, leading to stress, for you, it’s a chance to amplify your sense of achievement. Just be mindful not to let this enthusiasm lead to overindulgence, especially when it comes to food. Aside from that, embrace the day fully—whatever you engage in is bound to yield great results.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，你可能會收到一個意想不到的消息，來自一個你很久沒聽到的朋友，或者一個老室友。當你走到外面時，請睜大眼睛，因為你永遠不知道你可能會遇到誰。一位老導師可能就在附近，準備重新聯繫。您也可能會偶然發現一篇吸引您注意力的奇特新聞文章，其中有一張來自您童年社區的熟悉面孔。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, you may receive an unexpected message from a friend you haven't heard from in ages or perhaps an old roommate. Keep your eyes peeled when you step outside, as you never know who you might encounter. An old mentor could be nearby, ready to reconnect. You might also stumble upon a peculiar news article that draws your attention, featuring a familiar face from your childhood neighborhood.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你可能會發現自己急切地期待在別人的談話中暫停，這樣你就可以用你的想法跳進去。事實上，你可能根本不會退縮！為一些緊張局勢做好準備，因為不同的意見可能會導致激烈的交流。由於每個人都堅信自己是正確的，誤解可能會升級。然而，有一線希望：這種動態可能會為一些令人驚訝的富有成效的討論鋪平道路。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you might find yourself eagerly anticipating a pause in someone else's conversation so you can jump in with your thoughts. In fact, you may not hold back at all! Be prepared for some tension, as differing opinions could lead to heated exchanges. With everyone firmly believing they are correct, misunderstandings may escalate. However, there's a silver lining: this dynamic could pave the way for some surprisingly fruitful discussions.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，你的思緒今天可能會分散，把你拉向不同的方向。將你的精神能量集中在挑戰你智力的小任務上。預計您的能量水平會波動，因此請充分利用您的生產力時刻，並在需要時隨時喘口氣。考慮與主管討論20分鐘下午休息的好處，以幫助您充電並提高生產力。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, your thoughts may be scattered today, pulling you in various directions. Focus your mental energy on smaller tasks that challenge your intellect. Expect your energy levels to fluctuate, so make the most of your productive moments, and don’t hesitate to take a breather when needed. Consider discussing with your supervisor the benefits of a 20-minute afternoon break to help you recharge and enhance your productivity.

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你的聲音會比平時更重。過去，你的見解可能被忽視或很快被遺忘，但現在情況並非如此。你的話會引起深刻的共鳴，並廣泛傳播。因此，請勿回避，請公開分享您的想法和觀點。你的貢獻將產生重大影響。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, your voice will carry more weight than usual. In the past, your insights may have been overlooked or quickly forgotten, but that's not the case today. Your words will resonate deeply and spread far and wide. So, don’t hold back—share your thoughts and perspectives openly. Your contributions will make a meaningful difference.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，今天你可能會發現自己與傳來的情報不一致。某種自我中心感可能會影響你接受更多利他主義觀點的能力。挑戰自己，拓寬心態，並考慮周圍人的觀點。你會發現，通過將更多的自己奉獻給他人，你可以在生活中培養更大的尊重和更深的幸福感。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, you might find yourself at odds with the information coming your way, Pisces. It’s possible that a touch of self-centeredness is clouding your ability to embrace more altruistic perspectives. Challenge yourself to broaden your mindset and consider the viewpoints of those around you. You'll discover that by giving more of yourself to others, you cultivate greater respect and a deeper sense of happiness in your life.
